blocks.text: The chapter presents Wisdom and Folly as women who issue parallel public invitations, offer meals, and call especially to those lacking understanding. This paired picture frames their invitations as rival forms of desire with opposite destinations: Wisdom’s way leads toward life, while Folly’s guests are headed toward death. Verse 10 stands at the chapter’s center: fear of the LORD is identified as the beginning of wisdom, fitting Proverbs’ wider educational concern with wisdom, discipline, justice, and discernment.
